Data-centric informatics methods are becoming useful to determine material properties that are hard to measure or compute using traditional methods—due to the cost, time or effort involved—but for which reliable data either already exists or can be generated for at least a subset of the critical cases. Predictions may also be extrapolative—extending into new materials spaces—provided prediction uncertainties are properly taken into account.
